scope: capture foundation API and CLI in isolated local projects

boundaries.authentication: existing project token and explicit session parameters; product task scope

verified: Persistent annotation identity and capture version, incomplete after capture failure and aborted upload, restart restores input and preparation
Saved new-flow annotation cannot drop captureState or lose its identity after remove and re-add
Metadata preparation, raw PNG commit and result query share the same session/draft/annotation/version result
Unread commit and Send responses recover after restart; one screenshot asset and one task; CLI prepare/commit/result/send/asset-read use the same service
Stale capture completion is rejected; target/region/media/content-anchor edits advance version; comment text retains original capture
Explicit retry is idempotent for an old version across an unread response and restart, and permits a fresh frame at the next version
Two captures of the same moved object retain separate committed and rendered geometry and survive object deletion plus Send
Queue text edit preserves capture ownership and task ID/sequence; target edit requires a new capture; cancellation restores original draft evidence
Send atomically rejects incomplete and mismatched capture versions while retaining the draft and task count
Evidence is scoped in state, GET/HEAD/range/artwork/HTML preview and CLI read; generic asset registration/board/attachment/annotation/resource-bundle use cannot republish its asset identity

New cross-session task references are rejected; saved historical references continue through text edits; removal prevents re-add; cross-session historical context omits new capture and evidence assets

PNG signature, chunks, native CRC, complete IEND, deflate data, image dimensions and pixel scanlines are validated; unsupported JPEG, invalid bytes, CRC/deflate/dimension/size/mapping errors retain incomplete state
Media selected interval and actual playback time are separate evidence fields; content anchors and point geometry persist
Legacy annotations keep their existing fields and queue edit behavior

Child process exits with code 77 after final PNG rename and before SQLite completion; restart has no registered asset and incomplete annotation; GET result commits the same reserved capture and asset, then Send succeeds

failureInjection.responseLoss: Client deliberately leaves completed capture and Send response bodies unread, cancels each body, and restarts before result/send reconciliation.
failureInjection.partialUpload: Real HTTP request sends 30 of 78 bytes then destroys the request; restart restores prepared state and temporary partial file is removed.
failureInjection.crash: Isolated child service overrides captureResult to exit(77) when the reserved final file exists; byte upload returns connection failure before SQLite asset/capture commit.
failureInjection.historicalReferences: Fixture seeds an existing cross-session reference in its isolated SQLite database to model old stored data.
failureInjection.sendVersionMismatch: Fixture changes the isolated saved captureState version to exercise Send transaction rejection.

knownLimits: Current production chatbox UI does not call the new capture helpers.
The service records supplied rendered bounds, media state, scroll and viewport data; same-frame producer consistency is validated by the separate real screenshot prototype.
Only PNG capture evidence is supported in this foundation. General asset formats are unchanged.
Power-loss durability and automatic evidence garbage collection are future lifecycle work.

captureTestRoots.ownership: Created by tests/annotation-capture.test.ts, self-owned PNG and JSON fixtures only.
captureTestRoots.cleanup: Test teardown closes each service, terminates a surviving crash child if present, removes its own complete temporary root. The crash child exits 77; its restarted service closes before cleanup.

temporaryResources.sharedUserBoard: The repository .acanvas and its existing service were not opened, restarted or written by these capture tests.
temporaryResources.environmentFailureFixtures: The earlier restricted baseline run could leave temporary acanvas fixtures after listener startup failures; these unknown-to-this-capture-test roots are preserved. Capture-specific temporary roots are listed above.
